## Description

Linearizes non-linear multi-asset portfolio transition dynamics using Koopman operator observable dictionaries, applying Model Predictive Control (MPC) to optimize multi-period rebalancing under turnover constraints.

## Where it may fit

Institutional portfolio rebalancing with transaction cost and turnover constraints during macro shifts.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Multi-Asset Allocation Desks.

## Required data

Asset return panels, covariance matrices, transaction cost fee schedules, turnover limits.

## Caveats

Dictionary expansion size requires L1 regularization to prevent overfitting in multi-period optimization.
